name: LaMa Fill
description: Fills the masked part of a picture from its surroundings with LaMa, a model made for removing objects. Only the masked pixels change. It is a base, not a finished edit: feed it to an edit model (the Remove action does) or use it as it is for a plain object removal. The model works at 512 x 512, so give it a crop around the mask (Canvas Region) for a large picture.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.description: White is what to take away.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: A LaMa ONNX file. The picker offers the download, with its licence shown first.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: Auto uses the GPU when the pack's environment has the CUDA build of ONNX Runtime.
